name.la: Sacrum commercium sancti Francisci cum domina Paupertate
name.en-US: The Sacred Exchange between St. Francis and Lady Poverty (Sacrum commercium)
name.pt-BR: O Sagrado Intercâmbio de São Francisco com a Senhora Pobreza (Sacrum commercium)

description.la: Sacrum commercium beati Francisci cum domina Paupertate (1227), allegoria in qua Franciscus et fratres Paupertatem quaerunt et cum ea nuptias celebrant; prologus et capitula XXXII.
description.en-US: The Sacred Exchange between Blessed Francis and Lady Poverty (1227), the allegory in which Francis and his friars go looking for Poverty and celebrate their wedding with her; prologue and thirty-two chapters, in Latin. The English of Montgomery Carmichael (The Lady Poverty, 1901) is not imported here.
description.pt-BR: O Sagrado Intercâmbio do bem-aventurado Francisco com a Senhora Pobreza (1227), alegoria em que Francisco e os frades vão em busca da Pobreza e celebram as núpcias com ela.

la.editor: transcription of the critical text of Fontes Franciscani (1995) by M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari; edition not stated

sources.edition: Sacrum commercium, poliba.it "Fonti francescane" (Wayback Machine snapshot).
sources.description: Prologue and numbered chapters. Latin only.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text. The transcription (M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari, Biblioteca di Scienze del Cristianesimo, 2000-02) survives only in the Wayback Machine; it states no edition, but its biblical apparatus follows Fontes Franciscani (1995). Free in practice, edition unverified.
